outcome: Arrhythmias (composite of cardiac arrest, ventricular tachycardia/fibrillation, implantable cardioverter defibrillator implantation)
Arrhythmias (composite of advanced second- or third-degree atrioventricular block, sinoatrial dysfunction, pacemaker implantation)
Arrhythmias (composite of supraventricular tachyarrhythmias or extra systoles)
cohort: The study included 523,271 primiparous women who gave birth in Denmark between 1997 and 2016.
finding: Primiparous women who developed pre-eclampsia had a significantly and long-term increased rate of arrhythmias compared to those without pre-eclampsia.
